metadata.description: Open-source tooling for building and maintaining Claude Code plugins and skills.

plugins.name: 100xeval
plugins.description: Behavioral and static evaluation for Claude Code plugins: run a plugin against saved testcases, grade whether it queried the right data and presented it correctly, plus a run-free design-quality score.

plugins.name: drift-check
plugins.description: Cross-plugin drift review: when a PR edits a skill, find the sibling skills in your other plugins and report which siblings the change likely applies to. Non-blocking, report-only.
